doc.title: Joseph Daley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, March 18, 2018

title: Wisdom of age and goodbyes
summary: Daley reflects on learning from elders and they sign off.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I want to thank you for sharing your wisdom with me.

Yeah well thank you. You know as you get older and older and older you become wiser and wiser and wiser you know, mainly because you’ve had the experience of being around all the older people, and older people, they impart so much knowledge on you and a lot of that stuff you don’t get when you’re young. But as you get older and older those things kind of like stick into your psyche and then all of a sudden you’re saying okay, now I know why that person said this, why that person said that. All those things. Things that kind of just like went over your head when you were young and everything.
Great. Best of luck to you.
Oh yeah best of luck to you and congratulations, and I hope you continue doing this for many many more decades.
